Range Rover Velar
specialist service & repair

The Velar brought Ingenium engines, twin-screen Touch Pro Duo and 48V mild hybrid technology to the range. Its electronics are sophisticated and its Ingenium engines need precise oil care. We know both intimately.

Book on WhatsApp 055 747 9292

Known issues on the Range Rover Velar

These are the faults that bring Range Rover Velar owners to us most often. Each has a proven, permanent repair.

  • Touch Pro Duo screen freezing
  • Ingenium timing chain and oil dilution on diesels
  • 48V mild hybrid battery faults
  • Door handle deployment failures
  • Coolant leaks from the auxiliary pump

Generations: L560 · Years: 2017 – present
Engines covered: 2.0 Ingenium P250/P300 petrol, 2.0 D180/D240 diesel, 3.0 P400 MHEV

Frequently asked questions

How often should a Range Rover Velar be serviced?

Every 16,000 km or 12 months, with an interim oil change at 8,000 km recommended in Gulf conditions for the 2.0 Ingenium P250/P300 petrol and other engines fitted to the Range Rover Velar.

What are the most common Range Rover Velar problems?

On the Range Rover Velar we most often see touch pro duo screen freezing, ingenium timing chain and oil dilution on diesels, 48v mild hybrid battery faults. All are diagnosed and repaired in-house.

Do you use genuine parts on the Range Rover Velar?

Yes. Genuine Land Rover parts by default, with high-quality OE-equivalent options offered where they provide better value.
